models.name: ResNet50 (transfer learning, frozen backbone)
notes: Metrics: cell 28. Per-class values: cell 24 classification report. Misclassified 160 of 1600 test images (cell 30).
Confusion matrix and ROC AUC were read from the figures saved in cells 24 and 26 and cross-checked against the printed reports (rows sum to 400, diagonal 1440 = 90.00%).
Glioma recall is 0.71: 87 glioma scans were predicted as meningioma. Meningioma precision is 0.79.

Backbone frozen, Adam lr 1e-4; validation accuracy was still rising at epoch 15 (0.9580, cell 20). The validation split is optimistic because the training folder contains duplicate images (cell 6); the test figure above is the honest one.
Single run; no confidence intervals; softmax scores are not calibrated.

models.name: Custom CNN (3 conv blocks, trained from scratch)
notes: Metrics: cell 28 (model_comparison_results.csv matches). Per-class values: cell 24 classification report (2 decimals as printed).
Confusion matrix and ROC AUC were read from the figures saved in cells 24 and 26 (image outputs, not text) and cross-checked: every row sums to 400 and the diagonal sums to 1189 = 74.31% of 1600.
Meningioma recall is 0.25: the model labels most meningioma scans as glioma or notumor.
The saved training log (cell 18) stops during epoch 8 and validation accuracy swings between 0.25 and 0.83, so training was unstable and its final epoch is not recorded in the notebook.
Single run, single seed; no confidence intervals. Softmax scores are not calibrated (the notebook says so in cell 32).
